contract: Actionable alt-data axis for the Mastermind bot. Each signal: signal_score 0-100 (composite of weighted convergence + brain conviction + price confirm − extension), action ∈ {ACCUMULATE,WATCH,AVOID}, direction ∈ {long,short,neutral}, source ∈ {brain,deterministic}. The bot sizes through its OWN risk framework; this is an input, not an order. Brain calls are graded vs SPY (see calibration). An extended name is never ACCUMULATE. trump_linked / affiliations flag actor ties. rolling_over names (off_high≤−15% AND 20d<0 AND below 50dma) appear in broken_signals only — crowd attention, NOT entries. entry_tier (T1/T2/T3) = validated confluence buy gate signal.
regime_read: Convergence is concentrated in semiconductors, AI software and idiosyncratic corporate situations, but much of it mixes fundamental signals with sentiment or affiliations rather than independent capital-flow confirmation. With no completed track-record observations, conviction remains modest and near-extended names warrant patience.

calibration.note: No theses scored yet — the track record begins once the first check-by dates pass. Keep conviction modest until it does.

signals.thesis: MSFT shows diversified product and developer adoption through app demand, GitHub momentum and model-download activity, reinforced by a large patent cluster [app_demand] [github_momentum] [hf_model_momentum] [patent_cluster]. The factual Sam Altman partnership connects these usage signals to the AI ecosystem, while the Bill Ackman affiliation is supportive but qualitative [actor:Sam Altman] [actor:Bill Ackman]. Relative strength is positive without breaching the extension threshold.
second_order: NVDA — cloud and model-usage growth can pull through demand for AI accelerators
AMD — broader cloud AI deployment can support demand for alternative compute hardware
MU — expanding AI workloads can increase demand for high-performance memory

falsifier.text: App engagement, developer momentum and model downloads all roll over for a sustained period.

signals.thesis: PLTR combines accelerating federal-contract activity with a uniformly bullish analyst cluster and disclosed political/fund relationships [gov_contract] [analyst_upgrade_cluster] [actor:Marjorie Taylor Greene] [actor:Cathie Wood]. Retail and Stocktwits enthusiasm broaden the convergence but are correlated sentiment channels [retail_buzz] [stocktwits_bull]. The strongest caution is positioning: relative performance is already +30 percentage points versus SPY over 60 days, close enough to the extension boundary to favor WATCH rather than a fresh entry.
second_order: MSFT — enterprise AI and cloud infrastructure may benefit if government AI-software adoption broadens
BA — broader federal technology and defense spending can support adjacent government contractors

falsifier.text: Federal-contract acceleration reverses and subsequent analyst revisions turn predominantly negative.

signals.thesis: MRK has a potentially meaningful healthcare catalyst stack: multiple Phase 3 starts and an FDA label-expansion signal align with a special-situation channel [clinical_phase3_start] [fda_label_expansion] [special_situation]. The Trump-linked buy adds an unusual political datapoint [trump], but eleven trial starts are counterbalanced by four clinical halts, and the relevant healthcare bills are only introduced rather than enacted [bill:HR10087] [bill:S5180]. With relative strength already elevated, WATCH is more appropriate than treating the pipeline count as a confirmed payoff.
second_order: Oncology-care services — expanded cancer-treatment planning coverage could support coordination demand if HR10087 advances
Clinical-research organizations — a larger late-stage trial slate can increase outsourced development activity

falsifier.text: Clinical halts increase or the anticipated label expansion fails to produce a commercially meaningful opportunity.

signals.thesis: MU has the cleanest non-extended alignment: buying disclosures span four congressional members, insider activity is strongly positive, and a sizable patent cluster supports operating relevance rather than sentiment alone [congress_cluster] [insider_mspr] [patent_cluster]. The Ro Khanna affiliation and fully bullish Stocktwits reading add context, though the latter is a crowded-sentiment input rather than fundamental confirmation [actor:Ro Khanna] [stocktwits_bull]. Its negative 60-day relative performance leaves the signal unextended.
second_order: AMAT — memory-capex recovery could lift semiconductor-equipment demand, with its own congressional and patent signals
NVDA — stronger memory demand can support the broader AI-accelerator supply chain

falsifier.text: Insider activity turns net negative while congressional buying ceases and patent momentum materially weakens.

signals.clamped: lean 'overweight' → 'underweight' (deterministic witness); conviction 'medium' → 'low' (deterministic ceiling); action 'ACCUMULATE' → 'AVOID' (deterministic ceiling)

broken_signals.thesis: LUV's signal is event-driven: activist involvement associated with Paul Singer aligns with multiple recent material filings, while strong app ratings and a large review base indicate an established customer channel [activist_13d] [actor:Paul Singer] [material_8k] [app_demand]. Negative relative performance means the setup is not extended, but the evidence does not yet show that activism or app engagement is improving operating economics.
second_order: Airline suppliers — successful operational restructuring could modestly improve fleet and service spending
Domestic travel platforms — stronger Southwest customer engagement could support broader U.S. leisure-travel demand

falsifier.text: Activist involvement ends without measurable operational changes and app-demand indicators deteriorate.

disclaimer: An AI reading of the desk's own deterministic convergence — accountable and checkable, not a guarantee. Every call cites the channels/actors it is based on, is graded vs SPY over the horizon, and can be wrong or overconfident. The Mastermind sizes it through its own risk framework; treat as odds, not a forecast.
